subject: NorthBridge renewal: benchmarking request and bake-off notice
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@northbridge.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@northbridge.ai>, NorthBridge Procurement <procurement@northbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal timing & evaluation

Rishi,

Quick note — our NorthBridge platform renewal is coming up in late September and the stakeholders have asked that we run a short bake-off with a couple of vendors to validate throughput and unit economics before we sign. We really like Redwood's latency profile, but procurement has been instructed to gather a short benchmark set and terms comparison.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can you provide a standardized throughput run for our workload (avg prompt length ~220 tokens, peak concurrent requests ~1.1k, estimated 120k tokens/day)? CSV of latency / p99 / cost breakdown would be ideal.
- We want a 2-week evaluation window starting the week of Sep 1. During that window we may test dedicated pools.
- Please share a draft term sheet we can redline (SLA, data handling, termination, pricing cadence).

One of the vendors we're considering is Aether Labs — they're proposing a dedicated node trial as part of the bake-off. Can Redwood match a short dedicated capacity commitment for the trial?

I've attached an overview of our evaluation criteria and timeline.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Director, Product Operations
NorthBridge AI

Attachments: nb_rfp_overview.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@northbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timing & evaluation

Samira — thanks for the heads up and the RFP overview. We appreciate the transparency on the bake-off. Short answers up front:

- Yes, we can run a standardized throughput snapshot for your workload and produce a CSV with p50/p95/p99 and per-token cost estimates.
- We can provision a short dedicated pool for the Sep 1 test window (subject to size & advance notice).
- I'll send a draft term sheet for your procurement team to redline.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick call tomorrow (30 min) to confirm the exact concurrency profile and success criteria (latency thresholds, quality tolerance).
2) We'll run an initial internal benchmark against a replay of your sample prompts and share results within 48 hours.
3) Draft mutual action plan + term sheet delivered by Aug 22.

Looping in Marissa (sales lead) and Karthik (solutions/ops) so we can align on capacity and commercial flexibility.

Would 10:30 AM PT tomorrow work for a quick sync?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: NorthBridge RFP - urgent retentive bake-off

Team — forwarding NorthBridge's note. They're running a short competitive eval and procurement flagged a redline path. Key asks: throughput snapshot (sample workload: ~220 tokens avg, spikes to 1.1k concurrent), potential dedicated pool for 2-week trial starting Sep 1, and a draft term sheet.

Action items: 
- Karthik: can you confirm minimal dedicated pool size and an uplift pricing model we can offer for the trial (target: keep MRR impact minimal, but guarantee perf)? Need ETA on whether we can carve a 4-GPU pool from our Dedicated capacity for the window.
- Marissa: prepping save/displacement offer if Aether Labs pushes lower list price. Consider 10–12% off list + SLA credits + priority onboarding.
- I'll run a replay of their sample prompts through our internal perf harness and push results (CSV) to the Drive link.

Attachments: (none in this internal note)
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@northbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, NorthBridge Procurement <procurement@northbridge.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: NorthBridge: mutual action plan + benchmark snapshot

Samira — following our call, attached is the initial throughput snapshot from our replay (nb_throughput_results.csv) and a short mutual action plan to keep the window tight. Summary below:

What we ran:
- Replay of the sample prompt set you shared (avg 220 tokens; 120k tokens/day target)
- Concurrency scenario: 1.1k peaks, sustained 300 concurrent

Key numbers (from attached CSV):
- p50 latency: 85 ms
- p95 latency: 210 ms
- p99 latency: 420 ms
- Estimated per-1000-token cost (hosted profile): $0.77

Our offer for the Sep 1–14 bake-off:
- Dedicated 4xA100 pool for trial (isolated capacity), provisioning contingent on final MOU by Aug 28.
- 10% list discount on committed tier if you enter a 12-month renewal within 30 days of the trial.
- Performance SLOs for p95 and p99 during trial; SLA credits if we miss agreed thresholds.

Attached: nb_throughput_results.csv and a draft mutual action plan (also in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C).

Next: please confirm procurement path and whether your legal team prefers a full term-sheet or an NDA + redline doc. If you can send the redline by Aug 24 we'll aim to finalize the trial MOU by Aug 28.

Best,
Rishi

Attachments: nb_throughput_results.csv
From: Samira Khan <samira@northbridge.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@northbridge.ai>, NorthBridge Procurement <procurement@northbridge.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 24 Aug 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NorthBridge: mutual action plan + benchmark snapshot

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the perf CSV — helpful. A few notes from procurement and platform: 

- The numbers look promising, but to be competitive with Aether Labs we need Redwood to commit to dedicated capacity (not a best-effort carve) during the trial window and an improved commercial.
- Procurement requested we send a redline of the term sheet — attached is our starter redline (redline_term_sheet.pdf). Key asks: 1) explicit dedicated pool guarantee for Sep 1–14, 2) an availability SLO at p99 that mirrors our internal thresholds, 3) rollback clause if SLA misses more than 2x in the trial.
- If Redwood can commit to a guaranteed (reserved) trial pool + additional 2% on top of your proposed 10% discount (so 12% total), we will put Redwood as the preferred vendor for the trial and accelerate internal approvals.

Also flagging that time is tight — we need signed MOU no later than Aug 28 to provision the dedicated nodes.

Samira

Attachments: redline_term_sheet.pdf
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@northbridge.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, NorthBridge Procurement <procurement@northbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 Aug 2025 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NorthBridge: mutual action plan + benchmark snapshot — save plan

Hi Samira — thanks for the redline and the candid ask. We want to keep NorthBridge on Redwood. Here's what we can commit to immediately to secure the trial and address procurement's concerns:

Offer (trial & commercial):
- Guaranteed dedicated 4xA100 reserved pool for Sep 1–14 (we will reserve capacity in Dedicated and provide attestable provisioning logs).
- Commercial: 12% off list on the committed tier for a 12-month renewal signed within 30 days of trial close.
- SLA: we will mirror the p99 availability clause in your redline for the trial window; if missed more than twice, you get a rollback option plus SLA credits per the draft.

Operational support:
- Priority onboarding with a named solutions engineer (Karthik) and 24/7 triage for the trial window.
- We will run an initial smoke test 48 hours prior to Sep 1 and share access to a live perf dashboard.

Next steps:
1) We've uploaded an updated term sheet that incorporates the dedicated-pool language and the 12% discount — DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/s/nb-nonbinding-mou (expires Aug 28).
2) Please have procurement sign the MOU by Aug 28 so we can finalize provisioning.
3) Karthik will schedule the smoke test for Aug 30.

If you want, we can also add a one-time onboarding credit to offset any migration overhead.

Appreciate the opportunity to compete — looking forward to the trial.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, West Region
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
